overview.match: Sydney Kamlager-Dove is the U.S. Representative
overview.text: Sydney Kamlager-Dove is the U.S. Representative for California’s 37th District, a position she has held since 2023. She serves on the House Foreign Affairs Committee as the ranking member of the Subcommittee on South and Central Asia, and on the Judiciary Committee. She is the Whip of the Congressional Black Caucus and Policy Co-Chair of the Democratic Women’s Caucus. Before Congress, she served in the California State Senate and Assembly, and on the Los Angeles Community College District Board of Trustees. She previously worked for Rebuild LA and the Los Angeles Festival, two nonprofits focused on job creation and public arts after the 1992 riots.
